items.title: Construction of a regular M23-Galois extension of Q(t) and its rational specializations
items.author: Xiaoyu Huang; Blake Jackson; Kyu-Hwan Lee; Bjorn Poonen; Rachel Pries; Shaowu Zhang
items.difficulty_reason: The regular M23 realization requires a nonrigid seven-element Nielsen class, genus-four Belyi construction, algebraic recognition and descent over Q(sqrt(-23)), rational-function construction and geometric/arithmetic monodromy comparison through tame specialization. These are retained with author polynomial and verification assets, without executing or independently certifying them. Old207172 is only the six-line hyperbolic-triangle lemma456–465, not the main construction. Rational specializations and sporadic-group corollaries are uncounted consequences. Original authors state AI assistance for literature/code/hypothesis testing/computational strategies/checking/proofreading at619–624; the precise statement is retained without inferring core AI discovery or AI-free provenance.
